streamalerts.label: Stream & feed alerts
streamalerts.description: Announce lives, videos and feed items in a channel (Twitch, YouTube, Reddit, RSS, Dealabs).

g0.label: 📡 Subscriptions
g0.description: For Dealabs, the identifier is used as a filter keyword.

subscriptions.label: Subscriptions

platform.label: Platform
platform.help: Decides how the identifier is read, and what triggers an announcement: going live for Twitch, a new post for the others.

displayName.label: Display name
displayName.help: The name used in the announcement and in the test button's picker. Left empty, the bot fills it in itself after the first successful check.

channelId.label: Announcement channel
channelId.help: With no channel the subscription is still followed but nothing is posted: that is how you pause a source without losing its settings.

roleId.label: Role to mention
roleId.help: Mentioned at the start of the announcement. A role everyone can mention is enough — the bot does not need the « mention @everyone » permission for an ordinary role.

message.label: Custom message
message.help: Replaces the platform's default text. Variables: {name} for the source, {title} for the item's title, {url} for its link, {game} for the Twitch category. Empty, the default text is used.

subscriptions.help: One row per source. Row order does not matter — each is checked on its own, every two minutes. Twitch needs TWITCH_CLIENT_ID and TWITCH_CLIENT_SECRET in the bot's .env; the other platforms work without a key.

test.label: Test a subscription
test.help: Posts the source's latest item in its channel, without waiting for the next check.

msg.noItem: No item found on the source.
